name: TOKYO OHKA KOGYO CO., LTD.
summary: Tokyo Ohka Kogyo Co., Ltd. specializes in the production of advanced photoresists and high-purity chemicals essential for semiconductor manufacturing. They provide a comprehensive range of materials for both advanced and legacy semiconductor processes, supporting the fabrication of cutting-edge electronic devices. With a strong customer-oriented approach, they have established manufacturing and development sites in key semiconductor regions globally.
